description: List posts with optional filters for status, search text, date range, channel, and label. Returns paginated results with platform statuses and metrics, ordered newest-first by publishedAt if the post is live, else scheduledAt, else createdAt. Use this when the user wants to browse, filter, or check the status of existing posts as raw data (not the visual dashboard).

approvalStatus.description: Filter by team approval state (e.g. 'pending' for the approval queue).

assignedTo.description: Filter by who the post is assigned to: a user id, 'me' for the caller, or 'unassigned'. Orthogonal to status — a post can be scheduled AND assigned.

channelId.description: Only posts on this channel. Channel IDs come from list_channels.

from.description: Filter posts created on or after this ISO date.

labelId.description: Filter by a single label ID. Prefer labelIds.

labelIds.description: Filter by several label IDs (from list_labels). Combined per labelMode.

labelMode.description: How labelIds combine: 'or' (default) matches posts with any of them, 'and' only posts with all of them.

order.description: Direction of the timeline sort (published, else due, else created). 'desc' is the default and returns the most recent first. Use 'asc' to read what is coming NEXT — with a limit, 'desc' returns the posts scheduled furthest out, not the soonest.

recurring.description: Set true to return only posts attached to a recurring schedule.

scheduledFrom.description: Filter posts scheduled on or after this ISO date.

scheduledTo.description: Filter posts scheduled on or before this ISO date.

to.description: Filter posts created on or before this ISO date.

name: list_posts

approvalStatus.description: Team approval state: none, pending, approved or rejected.

approver.description: Who approved it: { id, name, image }. Null unless approvalStatus is approved.

assignee.description: Who is expected to act on it next: { id, name, image }. Null when nobody is.

author.description: Who wrote the post: { id, name, image }. Null when that account is gone.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time the post was created.

id.description: The post's ID, used by get_post, update_post, publish_post and delete_post.

mediaFiles.description: Media on the post itself: file IDs after create_post or update_post, full file objects from get_post and list_posts.

postPlatforms.description: One entry per destination, with its platform and its own publish status.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 time the post was published.

recurringSchedule.description: get_post and list_posts: the repeat schedule the post belongs to, or null.

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 time the post is scheduled for.

status.description: draft, scheduled, publishing, processing, published, partial or failed.

threadMediaFiles.description: get_post and list_posts: the media the thread parts reference. Not included in mediaFiles.

threadParts.description: For a thread post: its parts, in order.

timezone.description: Time zone the schedule was set in.

total.description: Posts matching the filters, across every page.

title: List posts
